scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
I'm the best craftsman out of what people call the Three Craftsmen of Ninja Tools.
They call me Murata Boshuu.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
在所谓的“忍者工具三匠”中，我可是最出色的工匠。
人们都叫我村田波修。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
I know how to create any armor and shield of the eastern world, and my shields are considered the best there is.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
我会制作东方世界所有的铠甲和盾牌，而我的盾牌更是被公认为天下第一。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
But seeing how you are an outsider...
Looks like I have no business with you.
Ehem~
scripts.translation:
[波修]
不过，看你像是个外乡人...
看来我跟你没什么生意可做。
咳~

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
I make the best shields for Ninjas of all ages,
But even I have some minimum requirements
scripts.translation:
[波修]
我制作过历代忍者中最顶级的盾牌，
但即便是我，也有最低的要求。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
It looks like what you need isn't a shield, but more levels.
Come back after you've grown a bit more.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
看来你需要的不是盾牌，而是更多的等级。
等你再成长一些，再来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
I'm the best craftsman out of what people call the Three Craftsmen of Ninja Tools.
They call me Murata Boshuu.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
在所谓的“忍者工具三匠”中，我可是最出色的工匠。
人们都叫我村田波修。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
They say it's three craftsmen, but the other two are probably scammers.
There's not a single craftsman better than I for ninjas in this world.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
虽然说是“三匠”，但另外两个多半是骗子。
这世上没有比我更懂忍者的工匠了。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
I know how to make all the eastern armor and shield.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
我会制作东方所有的铠甲和盾牌。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
Because the armor I'd create was so superior and defensive, when two people battle wearing armor made by me, no one can win!
scripts.translation:
[波修]
因为我制作的铠甲防御力太强了，如果两个人都穿着我做的铠甲战斗，谁也无法分出胜负！

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
For that reason, I no longer make any armor.
I'm only collecting armors nowadays, just to make sure my skills do not go to waste..
scripts.translation:
[波修]
因此，我不再制作铠甲了。
现在只是收集铠甲，以免我的技艺荒废罢了。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
But I feel so bored nowadays.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
不过，我最近感到很无聊。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
Now that I only collect armor, I feel like the creative flame within me is dying out.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
既然现在只是收集铠甲，我感觉我内心的创造之火正在熄灭。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
From what I heard, there's an armor overseas which I haven't even heard of.
It was called a... hmm.. what was it called?
scripts.translation:
[波修]
我听说海外有一种我从未听说过的铠甲。
它叫...嗯...叫什么来着？

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
^ff0000Guard[1]^000000? Well, it's a name like that.
I wish to see the real thing myself.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
^ff0000Guard[1]^000000？大概是个类似的名字。
我想亲眼看看实物。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
But obviously, it's probably worthless compared to the armor I make.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
不过显而易见，它肯定比不上我制作的铠甲。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
Do me a favor and I'll make you something special.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
帮我个忙，我就给你做点特别的东西。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
I'm not sure what I'll do, but I get the feeling I'll feel inspired once I see that armor.
How 'bout it~ Will you find me a ^ff0000Guard[1]^000000?
scripts.translation:
[波修]
我还不确定会做什么，但我觉得看到那件铠甲后，我会获得灵感。
怎么样~ 你愿意帮我找一件 ^ff0000Guard[1]^000000 吗？

scripts.text: Hmm.. I don't feel like it.
scripts.translation: 嗯...我不想。

scripts.text: Very well.
scripts.translation: 好吧。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
Ah~ What a shame..
You're missing out on an opportunity to get your hands on something made by a genius craftsman like myself...
scripts.translation:
[波修]
啊~ 真可惜...
你错过了获得像我这样天才工匠制作之物的机会...

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
Oh, Very well.
Get a move on.
Find the shield called ^ff0000Guard[1]^000000 and bring it to me.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
哦，好吧。
动作快点。
找到那件名为 ^ff0000Guard[1]^000000 的盾牌，带给我。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
Oh.. so did you bring it?
Show it to me...
Hmmmmm...
scripts.translation:
[波修]
哦...你把它带来了？
给我看看...
嗯嗯嗯...

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
Oh~ ! I see, it's even possible to slot armor!
scripts.translation:
[波修]
哦~！原来如此，竟然还可以给铠甲镶嵌插槽！

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
Ahh, Now I'm just itching to imitating this armor and making a slot on other armors.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
啊哈，我现在简直手痒，想要模仿这件铠甲，在其他铠甲上也做出插槽。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
If you have a regular non-slotted Arm Guard and a slotted Guard, I'll make the non-slotted one slotted at the cost of 10,000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:

如果你有一件普通的无插槽手臂防护具和一件带插槽的Guard，我愿意花费10,000 Zeny将无插槽的那件改造成带插槽的。

scripts.text:

How 'bout it? Want to try?
scripts.translation:

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text: Ok, sounds good.

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

In the process of slotting a weapon, your weapon will lose any refine points and slotted cards, if any.
Think this over with caution, and then decide if you really want to do this or not.
